jobs.title: Associate Director, Commercial Data Operations
jobs.description:
When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That’s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn’t mean we’re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

The Associate Director, Commercial Data Operations leads the delivery and reliability of data that supports US Commercial decisions, operations, reporting and advanced analytics at Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease. You will set priorities and operating standards across commercial data assets, partner with technology teams to deliver governed data products, and lead the response to material data issues. The role spans specialty pharmacy and distribution, patient services, claims, customer and product master data, customer engagement and performance data.

Accountabilities

Portfolio Leadership: Set and sequence priorities across new data sources, product launches, enhancements, and production support; translate business needs into a clear roadmap, delivery plans, and decisions on scope, timing, and dependencies.
Data Product Ownership: Define business outcomes, common definitions, ownership, and acceptance criteria for reusable commercial data products; partner with engineering on models, lineage, access, testing, and transition from build to sustained operations.
Source Onboarding and Integration: Assess internal and vendor data, contracts, and file specifications; coordinate design, historical loads, validation, and downstream readiness for reporting, Decision Science, CRM, and other consumers.
Launch Readiness: Map the end-to-end flow—from source and master data through ingestion, data products, CRM alignment, reporting, and alerts; confirm dependencies, testing, and cutover plans; ensure downstream consumers are ready before launch.
Production Reliability: Establish service expectations, monitoring, incident response, and escalation for critical feeds and pipelines; analyze recurring failures, drive corrective action with IT and vendors, and communicate business impact and recovery plans.
Architecture, MDM, and Change Stewardship: Review designs and source-to-target mappings for scalability, maintainability, and downstream impact; partner on HCP, HCO, and product identity, affiliations, hierarchies, and cross-system keys; align with enterprise standards while protecting US Commercial requirements.
Leadership of Partners and Teams: Direct internal team members and external partners; clarify accountabilities, coach strong technical and business judgment, and hold vendors accountable for quality, schedules, and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with Trade and Distribution, Patient Services, Market Access, Commercial Operations, Reporting and Insights, Decision Science, and IT; resolve competing priorities and provide concise updates on risks, decisions, and delivery status.
Data Quality and Controls: Define critical data elements, thresholds, and controls across freshness, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and reconciliation; sponsor automated checks, dashboards, exception ownership, and alerting; require evidence for validation and regression testing; maintain lineage, documentation, and issue history so consumers understand data limits and changes.

Essential Skills/Experience

Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience, with 8 or more years in pharmaceutical or healthcare commercial data management, operations or engineering, including leadership of complex initiatives.
Commercial data and MDM expertise: Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial data across specialty pharmacy or patient services, claims, CRM and performance. Understanding of HCP, HCO and product mastering, matching, affiliations and hierarchies, and their effect on downstream data products.
Technical judgment: Advanced SQL and practical Snowflake experience for profiling, reconciliation and root cause analysis. Ability to review data models, pipeline designs, transformations and architecture with engineering teams; working knowledge of Python and orchestration or transformation tools.
Data product and quality leadership: Experience defining reusable datasets, business rules, ownership, lineage, quality controls and release acceptance criteria across multiple data sources and consumers.
Delivery leadership: Proven ability to run a portfolio of concurrent requests, incidents and launches; prioritize by business impact; lead testing, cutovers and operational handover; and manage vendors and delivery partners.
Communication and influence: Ability to challenge ambiguous requirements, make tradeoffs clear, develop colleagues and influence senior business and technology stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

Desirable Skills/Experience

Rare disease and vendor knowledge: Experience with specialty pharmacy and distribution feeds, including patient status, dispense, inventory and shipment data; familiarity with Veeva, IQVIA, Komodo or similar sources.
Modern data platform delivery: Experience with Snowflake, Airflow, dbt, S3, secure sharing, Git based releases and data product frameworks across raw, staging and curated layers.
AI and Decision Science enablement: Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to data operations or quality monitoring, such as anomaly detection and investigation. Understanding of model inputs, scores and outputs used for field alerts, including validation, refresh timing and production support with Decision Science teams.
People and change leadership: Experience coaching data teams, managing external partners and improving operating practices during platform modernization or enterprise migration.

At Alexion, you will find a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and a diverse environment where your contributions are valued. You will have the opportunity to be at the forefront of rare disease research and make a meaningful difference in patients' lives.

Ready to lead and inspire? Apply now and take the first step towards a fulfilling career at Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease.

⠀

Annual base salary for this position ranges from 134,708.00 to 176,804.25.

AstraZeneca is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The range provided in this posting represents an offer pay range used in a majority of situations. The base pay offered will vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, and other specific business and organizational needs. In some cases, offers outside the range may also be considered to address unique circumstances.

In addition, our permanent positions offer an annual Variable Pay Bonus/Short Term Incentive opportunity as well as eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program (if applicable to role). Benefits offered for permanent roles include a competitive Flex Benefits & Retirement Savings Program, 4 weeks’ paid vacation, and annual Personal Days. Fixed Term Contract/Temporary positions (excluding students) are offered a Contract Benefits Program.

jobs.description:
Position Title:
Director, Data Governance

Position Type:
Regular - Full-Time

Grade:
Grade 07

Requisition ID:

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

As the Director, Data Platform Governance, you will lead the technology and execution capabilities that enable trusted, governed, measurable, and business-ready data across McCain. Reporting to the VP, Head of Data and Analytics, you will be responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and continuously improving enterprise data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata management, and data lifecycle capabilities.

Working in close partnership with the Business Transformation Head of Data Governance, you will help shape and execute the enterprise governance strategy, operating model, policies, stewardship framework, and data management capabilities required to support global business and digital transformation. Your work will enable operational excellence, supply chain effectiveness, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled decision-making.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a pragmatic builder, operator, and problem solver. You will connect governance practices to measurable business outcomes, lead the resolution of complex data issues, and ensure that enterprise data is fit for operational, analytical, and AI use.

What You’ll Be Doing.

Define and execute McCain’s enterprise data governance strategy, roadmap, operating model, policies, standards, controls, and stewardship practices in partnership with business transformation leadership.
Lead enterprise master data management capabilities across customer, product, material, supplier, vendor, finance, location, and supply chain data domains.
Establish governance councils, stewardship forums, ownership models, decision rights, accountability structures, KPIs, scorecards, and executive reporting.
Direct enterprise-wide data quality capabilities, including business rules, data profiling, monitoring, root-cause analysis, remediation programs, preventative controls, dashboards, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Establish metadata management and data intelligence capabilities, including business glossaries, critical data elements, technical and business metadata, data catalogs, data lineage, classification standards, and data discovery.
Lead enterprise data lifecycle and information governance practices, including retention, archiving, historical data management, disposition, regulatory compliance, and lifecycle controls.
Provide governance leadership across SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG, SimpleMDG, Blue Yonder, CRM platforms, the Enterprise Data Platform, analytics and AI platforms, integration platforms, and other enterprise applications.
Partner across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Customer Operations, Business Transformation, and Technology to align data priorities with transformation and operational objectives.
Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global Data Platform Governance organization while fostering accountability, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Influence senior leaders, manage priorities across multiple transformation initiatives, support regulatory and audit requirements, and drive measurable improvements in data quality and business performance.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
12 or more years of progressive experience in data management, data governance, master data management, or enterprise information management.
At least five years of experience leading enterprise governance or master data management organizations.
Strong expertise in SAP master data structures, processes, and governance.
Hands-on experience implementing or operating SAP MDG and/or SimpleMDG.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise data quality initiatives and building governance operating models and stewardship programs.
Strong understanding of ERP transformation programs and experience managing enterprise-scale, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and enterprise technologies such as Blue Yonder, CRM platforms, enterprise data platforms, data quality solutions, metadata management tools, data catalogs, and data lineage capabilities.
Understanding of supply chain, customer, commercial, finance, product, supplier, and operational data domains.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, build alignment across business and technology teams, and translate governance concepts into measurable operational results.
A pragmatic, hands-on approach to problem-solving, execution, organizational change, and continuous improvement.

About The Team.

You will be part of McCain’s global Data and Analytics organization within the Chief Information & Technology Organization, reporting to the VP, Head of Data and Analytics. This role has people-leadership responsibility and will recruit, lead, mentor, and develop the Data Platform Governance organization.

The team works in close partnership with the Business Transformation Data Governance Office and collaborates across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Sales, Customer Operations, and Technology. Together, these groups establish shared accountability for enterprise data and enable global transformation priorities.

About McCain.

Leadership principles.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

AI & Digital Capabilities.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

The McCain Experience.

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success. Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you’ll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we’re better together.

Our purpose is grounded in building meaningful relationships. We’re big believers in the power of working together in person. It helps us stay connected, collaborate more effectively, and grow as a team. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility. Most office-based roles follow a hybrid model, with the option to work remotely two days a week. There may be exceptions depending on the role and location, so we encourage you to speak with your recruiter for more details.

Compensation Package
: $146,200.00 - $195,000.00 . CAD annually + Bonus eligibility + Long-term incentive eligibility

The above reflects the target compensation range for the position at the time of posting. Hiring compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education and training, and other organizational needs. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We understand and appreciate that each person’s needs are unique and ensure our benefits & well-being programs reflect that. Employees are eligible for the following benefits: health coverage (medical, dental, vision, prescription drug), retirement savings benefits, and leave support including medical, family and bereavement. Well-being programs include vacation and holidays, company-supported volunteering time, and mental health resources. jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Science

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team is responsible for delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models that support Mastercard’s Identity and risk products across the payment networks. These models are designed to be production-ready and to power high-value capabilities that protect digital transactions and enable trusted decisioning at scale.

Beyond model development, the organization is responsible for building scalable, repeatable, and resilient data science capabilities that cover the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from data acquisition and feature engineering through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. These systems must not only perform effectively in production, but also be built in a way that is industrialized, maintainable, and aligned with broader business and platform needs.

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Within this mission, the Identity Data Science portfolio plays a significant role in developing intelligence-driven solutions that improve how risk is understood and managed across the merchant lifecycle.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Director to lead a Data Science team that focuses on solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring. This role is critical in driving the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability within the Identity Data Science portfolio. This includes setting the strategy for how merchant intelligence is built and scaled, guiding the development of reusable data science assets and profiling frameworks, and ensuring strong execution across product, engineering, and data science partners. You will help shape both the technical direction and operational model needed to turn this capability into a durable and scalable advantage.

Role

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute the strategy for solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring through the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams of Data Scientists, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management
Build a strong team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
Guide the design of scalable machine learning and analytical systems using modern data and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Sparks.
Establish best practices for problem framing, technique selection, experimentation, and validation across the team
Ensure teams identify appropriate approaches for business problems and rigorously validate solutions against both technical and business outcomes
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate strategic needs into data science roadmaps and deliverables
Drive Agile delivery practices that support iterative development, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement
Promote reusable data assets, standardization, and scalable workflows that strengthen long-term execution
Communicate strategy, progress, trade-offs, and business value clearly to senior leadership
Balance long-term vision with near-term delivery to maximize impact and time-to-value

All About You

Essential Skills to be successful:

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Data Science, ML, or related field
Extensive experience leading a Data Science team and drive innovation with inspiration.
Experienced being a great people leader but able to dig into the work where necessary
A proven track record of deploying high performance machine learning models at scale in a production environment
Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, along with experience using scalable Machine Learning and Cloud frameworks
Strong ability to guide teams in identifying appropriate techniques and validating solutions rigorously
Critical thinking and a drive to produce high-quality work, ensuring that all solutions meet rigorous standards
Demonstrated success translating complex business problems into strategic data science initiatives. Ability to lead through ambiguity and change
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with the ability to drive iterative delivery across cross-functional teams
Excellent stakeholder management, communication to both technical and non-technical audiences, and leadership skills
Proven ability to build teams, influence roadmaps, and deliver measurable business value in complex environments
High-energy and self-driven orientation

Nice to Have

Experience building or scaling shared data science platforms, registries, or enterprise data assets
Familiarity with merchant risk, fraud, or identity ecosystems
Experience driving cross-team standardization and reusable capabilities
Exposure to governance frameworks for model validation and AI systems

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This is a pipeline posting for future opportunities within our team.

Pay Ranges

Vancouver, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: AI Learning Associate Director - Learning and Development (18-month contract)
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

AI is transforming how organizations operate, create value, and develop talent. As EY Canada accelerates its AI transformation, L&D continuous to play a critical role in helping our people build the skills, mindsets, and behaviours needed to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

As the AI Learning Associate Director, you will serve as a strategic advisor and learning capability leader responsible for shaping, scaling and activating EY Canada's AI learning strategy, driving enterprise-wide AI skill development, and enabling our people to adopt AI in ways that create measurable business impact.

Reporting to the L&D Business Partner and working in close partnership with EY Canada's Chief Technology Officer and the Office of the CTO, you will help shape and execute enterprise-wide learning strategies that drive AI adoption, support workforce transformation, and build future-ready capabilities across the organization.

This highly visible role requires a blend of learning expertise, business acumen, stakeholder management, and change leadership. You will work across service lines, talent, technology, and leadership teams to identify emerging capability needs, design scalable solutions, and translate complex AI concepts into meaningful learning experiences that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires an agile, builder's mindset and the ability to thrive in a rapidly evolving environment where priorities, technologies, and workforce needs continue to shift. The successful candidate will be comfortable navigating ambiguity, rapidly translating emerging opportunities into action, and continuously adapting learning strategies to keep pace with change.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

Partner with senior business, L&D, and technology leaders to define capability priorities that support EY Canada's AI transformation strategy.
Develop and execute a comprehensive AI learning roadmap aligned to evolving business priorities and emerging technology trends.
Identify opportunities to accelerate AI adoption through innovative learning experiences, performance support tools, and capability-building initiatives.
Lead the firmwide design, development, and deployment of enterprise AI learning programs, learning paths, campaigns, and experiences.
Translate emerging AI priorities into scalable learning solutions that drive behaviour change and business impact.
Curate and integrate learning resources, programs, platforms, certifications, and thought leadership content to support a continuous learning culture.
Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic AI learning initiatives, ensuring delivery excellence and strong learning outcomes.
Collaborate with subject matter experts, external vendors, and subject matter experts across the business to lead the development of high-quality, business-relevant content and experiences.
Influence senior stakeholders and navigate competing priorities to achieve program objectives and organizational goals.
Monitor adoption trends, learner engagement, and business feedback to continuously evolve capability-building strategies.
Manage select program budgets, vendor relationships, and governance activities to ensure operational excellence.
Partner with Brand Marketing Communications and leadership teams to develop effective engagement, activation, and reinforcement plans.

A successful candidate for the AI Learning Associate Director role at EY Canada will possess a unique blend of skills, experience, and attributes that enable them to thrive in a fast-paced, transformative environment. Here’s what we’re looking for:

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business priorities into innovative learning solutions.
Strong understanding of emerging AI trends, technologies, and use cases, with the ability to assess implications for workforce capability development and organizational transformation.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in fast-changing environments, bringing an entrepreneurial, agency-oriented mindset that embraces experimentation, rapid iteration, continuous learning, and adaptation as technologies and business priorities evolve.
Strong consulting and influencing skills, including experience working with executive stakeholders.
Deep understanding of adult learning principles, capability development, and organizational change.
Strong business acumen and curiosity regarding the impact of AI on workforce transformation and future skills.
Experience using data to guide decision-making and measure program effectiveness.
Exceptional project leadership, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive progress through collaboration and influence.

To qualify for the role, you must have

8+ years of experience in learning and development, talent development, workforce transformation, change management, or related fields.
Experience working with an LMS (preferably SuccessFactors) a plus.
Proficient in advanced capabilities in Excel (use of pivot tables and v-lookup) and PowerPoint.
Proficient in Zoom, MS Teams, Office 360 and SharePoint.
Demonstrated proficiency using AI and AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot and similar solutions) to enhance personal effectiveness, accelerate content creation, synthesize information, support decision-making, and improve business outcomes.
Experience applying AI to solve business problems, improve ways of working, or drive capability-building and adoption initiatives within an organization.
Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

EY reports salary ranges in accordance with applicable provincial pay transparency legislation. Individual salaries within the anticipated salary ranges noted below are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to internal equity, education, relevant experience, knowledge, and applicable skill sets.

Vancouver/Victoria: $126,800 to $211,300
Dieppe: $114,000 to $190,000

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At EY, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools as one element of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and improve the candidate experience. While AI supports us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain integral in our candidate experience. We are committed to the responsible use of AI, and our practices are continuously reviewed and refined to ensure they align with ethical principles and regulatory requirements.

new_jobs.title: Director, Data Science
new_jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Science

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team is responsible for delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models that support Mastercard’s Identity and risk products across the payment networks. These models are designed to be production-ready and to power high-value capabilities that protect digital transactions and enable trusted decisioning at scale.

Beyond model development, the organization is responsible for building scalable, repeatable, and resilient data science capabilities that cover the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from data acquisition and feature engineering through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. These systems must not only perform effectively in production, but also be built in a way that is industrialized, maintainable, and aligned with broader business and platform needs.

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Within this mission, the Identity Data Science portfolio plays a significant role in developing intelligence-driven solutions that improve how risk is understood and managed across the merchant lifecycle.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Director to lead a Data Science team that focuses on solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring. This role is critical in driving the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability within the Identity Data Science portfolio. This includes setting the strategy for how merchant intelligence is built and scaled, guiding the development of reusable data science assets and profiling frameworks, and ensuring strong execution across product, engineering, and data science partners. You will help shape both the technical direction and operational model needed to turn this capability into a durable and scalable advantage.

Role

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute the strategy for solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring through the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams of Data Scientists, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management
Build a strong team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
Guide the design of scalable machine learning and analytical systems using modern data and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Sparks.
Establish best practices for problem framing, technique selection, experimentation, and validation across the team
Ensure teams identify appropriate approaches for business problems and rigorously validate solutions against both technical and business outcomes
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate strategic needs into data science roadmaps and deliverables
Drive Agile delivery practices that support iterative development, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement
Promote reusable data assets, standardization, and scalable workflows that strengthen long-term execution
Communicate strategy, progress, trade-offs, and business value clearly to senior leadership
Balance long-term vision with near-term delivery to maximize impact and time-to-value

All About You

Essential Skills to be successful:

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Data Science, ML, or related field
Extensive experience leading a Data Science team and drive innovation with inspiration.
Experienced being a great people leader but able to dig into the work where necessary
A proven track record of deploying high performance machine learning models at scale in a production environment
Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, along with experience using scalable Machine Learning and Cloud frameworks
Strong ability to guide teams in identifying appropriate techniques and validating solutions rigorously
Critical thinking and a drive to produce high-quality work, ensuring that all solutions meet rigorous standards
Demonstrated success translating complex business problems into strategic data science initiatives. Ability to lead through ambiguity and change
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with the ability to drive iterative delivery across cross-functional teams
Excellent stakeholder management, communication to both technical and non-technical audiences, and leadership skills
Proven ability to build teams, influence roadmaps, and deliver measurable business value in complex environments
High-energy and self-driven orientation

Nice to Have

Experience building or scaling shared data science platforms, registries, or enterprise data assets
Familiarity with merchant risk, fraud, or identity ecosystems
Experience driving cross-team standardization and reusable capabilities
Exposure to governance frameworks for model validation and AI systems

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This is a pipeline posting for future opportunities within our team.

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD
